info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Ratings-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Ratings API allows users to retrieve ratings for rideshare rides. This endpoint facilitates access to aggregated ratings, enabling consumers to assess ride quality and user experiences. Typical use cases include evaluating driver performance, identifying trends in customer satisfaction, and improving service delivery through data insights. This API is essential for developers building applications that offer transparency and enhance user decision-making in rideshare services.

get.summary: Retrieve the rating for a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the rating of a specific ride based on user feedback. It is designed to help assess overall customer satisfaction regarding rides offered.
